verdict.rationale: ClickUp's evidence shows general AI agents (Brain², Codegen Agent) and a mobile-capable task/comment system, but nothing describes reviewing AI-generated code diffs with line-specific comments from a mobile app or the agent iterating based on that feedback. Missing for 10: any mention of code diff review UI, line-level commenting on code, mobile-specific code review workflow, or agent re-iteration based on such comments.
